question: HTML stands for ____________.
explanation: HTML stands for Hyper Text Markup Language.

question: The ____________ is an evolving language with different versions supporting different features.
explanation: HTML is an evolving language with multiple specifications and versions.

question: ____________ is currently used because it supports mobile technology.
explanation: HTML5 supports native mobile features, responsive design, and multimedia.

question: The ____________ tag is used to create a form.
explanation: The <form> element encapsulates form controls and data submission.

question: <input type="____________"> defines a color picker.
explanation: The color input type creates an interactive color picker interface.

question: <input type="____________"> defines a field for entering a number.
explanation: <input type="number"> limits input to numerical values.

question: <input type="____________"> defines a field for entering a URL.
explanation: The url input type performs automatic validation on web addresses.

question: <input type="____________"> defines an image as a submit button.
explanation: <input type="image"> displays an image that triggers form submission when clicked.

question: <input type="____________"> defines a date picker with the year, month, and day.
explanation: The date input type generates a calendar date picker control.

question: <input type="____________"> defines a field for an email address.
explanation: The email input type validates standard user@domain format.

question: <input type="____________"> defines a month and year control in format 'YYYY-MM'.
explanation: <input type="month"> selects a month and year without time or day.

question: <input type="____________"> defines the range control.
explanation: The range input type renders an interactive numeric slider control.

question: <input type="____________"> defines a date picker that includes the year, month, day, and time.
explanation: <input type="datetime-local"> provides inputs for both calendar date and local time.

question: <input type="____________"> defines a control for entering a time.
explanation: <input type="time"> allows selecting time (hours and minutes).

question: <input type="____________"> defines a week and year control.
explanation: <input type="week"> defines a week and year selection input.

question: <input type="____________"> defines a text field for entering a search string.
explanation: <input type="search"> is tailored for entry of search queries.

question: <input type="____________"> defines a file-select field and a 'Browse' button for file uploads.
explanation: The file input type allows users to choose files from device storage.

question: <input type="____________"> is used to define input fields that should contain a telephone number.
explanation: <input type="tel"> captures and validates phone numbers.

question: The default range of range control is ____________.
explanation: By default, an HTML5 range input runs from 0 to 100 if min and max are not specified.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag specifies that an input field should be disabled.
explanation: The disabled attribute makes an input non-editable and non-submittable.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag specifies the maximum value for an input field.
explanation: The max attribute defines the upper numerical or date limit.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag specifies the minimum value for an input field.
explanation: The min attribute defines the lower limit for acceptable values.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag specifies a regular expression to check the input values.
explanation: The pattern attribute takes a regex expression used for client-side form validation.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag specifies that an input field is read only.
explanation: The readonly attribute keeps the field visible and copyable, but prevents modifications.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag acts as a temporary label showing the purpose of a text field without requiring a label tag.
explanation: Placeholder provides hint text inside an empty input control.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag specifies that an input field is required.
explanation: The required attribute stops form submission if the input is left empty.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag specifies whether a form or input field should have autocomplete on or off.
explanation: Autocomplete toggles predictive automated input filling.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag specifies that the input field should automatically get focus when the page loads.
explanation: The autofocus attribute puts active cursor focus on that element on initial load.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag specifies the height and width of an <input type="image">.
explanation: Height and width define display dimensions for graphical image buttons.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag specifies that the user is allowed to enter more than one value in the <input> element.
explanation: The multiple attribute permits multiple email addresses or file uploads.

question: The ____________ attribute works with input types like email and file.
explanation: The multiple attribute is valid on email and file input elements.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag is used to identify the HTML element uniquely through the Document Object Model.
explanation: The id attribute provides a unique identifier within the DOM.

question: The ____________ attribute of <input> tag is used to apply CSS style to the individual input element.
explanation: The class attribute assigns shared style rule hooks.

question: The ____________ tag is used by search engines to search information that is provided with the web page.
explanation: <meta> tags define structured document metadata indexed by search engines.

question: The ____________ tag is placed inside the <head> tag.
explanation: Meta elements belong exclusively within the HTML <head> block.

question: ____________ will not be displayed on the web page.
explanation: Metadata is browser/crawler readable but not rendered directly in the visual viewport.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies the name of the metadata.
explanation: The name attribute gives property labels like author, keywords, or description.

question: The ____________ attribute of <meta> tag can have any textual matter related to the name.
explanation: The content attribute holds the value paired with the name or http-equiv attribute.

question: The ____________ attribute of <meta> tag specifies the character encoding used by the document.
explanation: The charset attribute defines encoding standards like UTF-8.

question: <meta charset="UTF-8"> is for ____________ characters.
explanation: TPS classifies UTF-8 support under standard international and Indian character representations.

question: <meta charset="Big5"> is for ____________ language.
explanation: Big5 is a traditional Chinese character encoding standard.

question: The ____________ attribute of <meta> tag is used for HTTP response message headers.
explanation: http-equiv simulates HTTP header directives directly from the client document.

question: The page will get refreshed using ____________ value of the http-equiv attribute.
explanation: http-equiv="refresh" reloads the page or redirects after a specified duration.

question: The browser sends cookies back to the server using the ____________ value of http-equiv attribute.
explanation: http-equiv="set-cookie" manages client-to-server cookie transmission.

question: The ____________ value specifies the character encoding for the document in http-equiv.
explanation: content-type specifies MIME type and encoding parameters.

question: The page session will expire at a specified date and time using the ____________ value of http-equiv attribute.
explanation: expires sets a cache or session invalidation timestamp.

question: CSS stands for ____________.
explanation: CSS stands for Cascading Style Sheets.

question: ____________ allows you to control the look and feel of several pages by changing a single source.
explanation: CSS centralizes design rules across entire websites.

question: A ____________ indicates the HTML element you want to style.
explanation: The selector targets HTML DOM nodes for stylistic formatting.

question: The ____________ block can contain one or more declarations separated by a semicolon.
explanation: The declaration block is enclosed within curly brackets {} and houses CSS properties.

question: Each declaration contains a property name and value, separated by a ____________.
explanation: In CSS, a colon (:) divides the property from its assigned value.

question: A ____________ is a type of attribute of an HTML element styled in CSS.
explanation: A property is the stylistic characteristic being configured (e.g., color, margin).

question: ____________ are assigned to CSS properties.
explanation: Values determine the specific behavior or aesthetic for a given CSS property.

question: There are ____________ methods of implementing styling information to an HTML document.
explanation: The three methods are Inline, Internal (Embedded), and External.

question: An ____________ style sheet uses the style attribute in the HTML start tag.
explanation: Inline CSS is applied directly inside an element using style="".

question: ____________ CSS is used to apply CSS to a single line or element.
explanation: Inline CSS operates only on that specific HTML element.

question: An example of Inline CSS is ____________.
explanation: <body style="background-color: red"> correctly employs inline style syntax.

question: Internal CSS is also called ____________ CSS.
explanation: Internal CSS declared within <style> tags is also termed Embedded CSS.

question: An ____________ style sheet is used to apply CSS to a single document or page.
explanation: Internal style sheets define rules scoped to one individual HTML document.

question: Internal CSS is written inside the ____________ tag within the head section of HTML.
explanation: Internal CSS sits within <style>...</style> in the document <head>.

question: An ____________ style sheet is used when you want to make changes on multiple pages.
explanation: External style sheets control design across an unlimited number of linked web pages.

question: An ____________ style sheet facilitates changing the look of the entire website by changing just one file.
explanation: A single external .css file styles the entire website globally.

question: In external CSS, the ____________ tag should be placed inside the head section.
explanation: The <link> element connects external stylesheets to HTML pages.

question: An external style sheet must be saved with the ____________ extension.
explanation: External stylesheet files use the standard .css file extension.

question: The ____________ CSS file should not contain any HTML tags.
explanation: External .css files contain strictly CSS declarations and no HTML tags.

question: The ____________ property changes the color of text in CSS.
explanation: The 'color' property sets element foreground text color.

question: The ____________ property sets background color in your webpage.
explanation: The background-color property changes background hue.

question: The ____________ property is used to make text bold.
explanation: font-weight: bold configures the thickness of typographic characters.

question: The ____________ property is used to make text italics.
explanation: font-style: italic slants the typography.

question: The ____________ property is used to decorate text with lines.
explanation: text-decoration controls underline, overline, and strike-throughs.

question: The ____________ value of text-decoration property is used to add strike-through marks.
explanation: text-decoration: line-through strikes a line across the center of text.

question: The ____________ value of text-decoration property is used to underline text.
explanation: text-decoration: underline renders a horizontal line under text.

question: The ____________ value of text-decoration property is used to overstrike above the text.
explanation: text-decoration: overline draws a line directly above characters.

question: The ____________ value of text-decoration property is used to remove underlines from hyperlinks.
explanation: text-decoration: none clears native browser hyperlink underlines.

question: The ____________ property is used to control horizontal alignment of block-level text.
explanation: text-align sets alignment to left, right, center, or justify.

question: The ____________ property is used to control the font face/family.
explanation: font-family dictates the typographic typeface.

question: The ____________ property allows you to control the size of the font.
explanation: font-size sets typographic scale in pixels, points, or rems.

question: The ____________ property helps in controlling horizontal spacing between characters of text.
explanation: letter-spacing adjusts whitespace tracking between individual letters.

question: The ____________ property is used when you want to add blank spaces around the inner content of an element.
explanation: Padding adds internal breathing room between content and element border.

question: The ____________ property adds a border to a web page element.
explanation: The border shorthand property configures width, style, and color.

question: The ____________ property is used to set an image as the background of a webpage.
explanation: background-image: url(...) assigns bitmap or vector imagery behind content.

question: The ____________ property sets margin area on the left side of the element.
explanation: margin-left pushes an element outwards away from items to its left.

question: The ____________ selector selects the id attribute of an HTML element to select a specific element.
explanation: The ID selector targets unique elements possessing a matching id attribute.

question: The ID selector is written with the ____________ character followed by the id name.
explanation: The hash (#) symbol prefixes all CSS ID selectors.

question: The ____________ selector selects HTML elements with a specific class attribute.
explanation: Class selectors target one or more elements sharing identical class names.

question: A Class selector is used with the ____________ character followed by the class name.
explanation: A period (.) prefixes class selectors in CSS syntax.

question: The class name should not start with a ____________.
explanation: CSS class names cannot begin with numeric digits.

question: The ____________ selector is used as a wildcard character.
explanation: The universal selector (*) targets every element in the DOM tree.

question: The ____________ selector is used to select all the elements with the same style definitions together.
explanation: Grouping selectors shares styles across multiple distinct element rules.

question: ____________ are used to separate each selector in grouping.
explanation: Commas (,) delimit elements in grouped selector chains.

question: The ____________ property is used to set position for an element in CSS.
explanation: The position property dictates the positioning context.

question: There are ____________ main types of positioning in CSS according to textbook definitions.
explanation: The HSC syllabus highlights four primary positioning types: static, fixed, relative, and absolute.

question: ____________ positioning is the default position for HTML elements.
explanation: HTML elements are positioned static by default in document flow.

question: The ____________ positioning property helps to put text fixed relative to the browser viewport.
explanation: Fixed positioning pins elements in the exact viewport coordinate regardless of scrolling.

question: The ____________ property forces an element into a fixed position relative to the browser window.
explanation: position: fixed keeps elements anchored against viewport bounds.

question: The ____________ positioned element will not move even when the page is scrolled.
explanation: Fixed positioned items remain static relative to the screen on scroll.

question: The ____________ positioning property is used to set the element relative to its normal position.
explanation: Relative positioning offsets elements starting from their normal document flow point.

question: The ____________ positioning property sets an element in a specific location and is not affected by normal page flow.
explanation: Absolute positioning pulls elements entirely out of normal document flow.

question: Absolute positioning property positions the element at the specified coordinates relative to screen ____________ corner.
explanation: Default absolute Cartesian coordinates start relative to the top-left origin.

question: ____________ is a CSS property written in a CSS file or element style to define content flow.
explanation: The float property shifts elements left or right while allowing text wrap.

question: ____________ keeps the element floating on the left side of the container.
explanation: float: left pushes elements to the container's left edge.

question: ____________ keeps the element floating on the right side of the container.
explanation: float: right docks elements to the container's right margin.

question: ____________ is the default float property which shows the element as it is.
explanation: float: none prevents floating and keeps normal placement.

question: The ____________ property in CSS defines how components are going to be placed/rendered on the web page.
explanation: The display property specifies rendering behaviors such as inline, block, or flex.

question: The ____________ value of display property is used to display an element as an inline element.
explanation: display: inline allows elements to flow alongside text without forcing line breaks.

question: The ____________ value is used to display an element as a block element.
explanation: display: block makes an element start on a new line and span full available width.

question: The ____________ value allows setting explicit width and height while flowing with adjacent content.
explanation: Inline-block formats an element inline while allowing box width/height sizing.

question: Using the ____________ value of display, the element is completely removed from the page layout.
explanation: display: none hides elements completely without leaving blank spacing.

question: The ____________ tag defines an Ordered list.
explanation: <ol> creates numbered or ordered sequences.

question: An ____________ list can be numerical or alphabetical.
explanation: Ordered lists support 1, A, a, I, and i formats.

question: The ____________ attribute is used to specify the numbering type for ordered list items.
explanation: The type attribute selects Arabic numerals, letters, or Roman numerals.

question: The default value of the type attribute of an ordered list is ____________.
explanation: Ordered lists default to decimal numbers beginning at 1.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies that items of the list are specified in reverse order.
explanation: The reversed boolean attribute counts descending order.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies the starting number of the first item in an ordered list.
explanation: start sets the initial numerical value for the list sequence.

question: An Unordered list is created using the ____________ tag.
explanation: <ul> creates bulleted lists.

question: An ____________ list is also called a bulleted list.
explanation: Unordered lists render with bullet markers by default.

question: Each list item starts with the ____________ tag.
explanation: The <li> tag wraps individual items inside <ol> and <ul> lists.

question: The ____________ attribute of <ul> tag sets the list item marker to disc, circle, or square.
explanation: The type attribute selects disc, circle, or square bullet shapes.

question: ____________ is the default value of type attribute of <ul> tag.
explanation: The filled disc marker is the browser default for <ul>.

question: To define a description/definition list, the ____________ tag is used.
explanation: <dl> defines a description list.

question: The ____________ tag is used to define the term in a definition list.
explanation: <dt> defines the definition or description term.

question: The ____________ tag is used to define the term's description/definition.
explanation: <dd> encapsulates the detailed definition data.

question: A list within another list is called a ____________ list.
explanation: A nested list is structured inside an outer list item.

question: MPEG stands for ____________.
explanation: MPEG stands for Moving Pictures Experts Group.

question: AAC stands for ____________.
explanation: AAC stands for Advanced Audio Coding.

question: The ____________ element enables embedding audio files into webpages.
explanation: The <audio> element provides standard browser playback for audio files.

question: Using the ____________ attribute of <audio> tag, audio will start playing as soon as it is ready.
explanation: The autoplay attribute triggers immediate playback upon file readiness.

question: The ____________ attribute of <audio> tag defines that audio controls should be displayed.
explanation: The controls attribute displays play, pause, seek, and volume interfaces.

question: The ____________ attribute of <audio> tag sets the audio to start over again every time it is finished.
explanation: The loop attribute restarts audio in a continuous cycle.

question: The ____________ attribute of <audio> tag specifies that the audio output should be muted.
explanation: muted sets the initial audio playback volume to zero.

question: The ____________ attribute of <audio> tag specifies the URL of the audio file.
explanation: src specifies the file location or URL of the media file.

question: The ____________ attribute is used to add audio controls such as play, pause, and volume.
explanation: controls injects the browser's built-in playback UI.

question: The ____________ tag is used to specify multiple media resources for media elements.
explanation: <source> provides fallback audio or video streams in alternating formats.

question: The ____________ tag is used to embed video into a web page.
explanation: The <video> tag handles native video rendering in HTML5.

question: The ____________ attribute defines the link to the video file.
explanation: The src attribute points to the video stream or MP4/WebM resource.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies that the video will start playing as soon as it is ready.
explanation: Autoplay initiates video playback without waiting for explicit user interaction.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies that video controls should be displayed.
explanation: Controls renders the default browser player toolbar.

question: The ____________ attribute sets the height of the video player in pixels.
explanation: Height sets vertical dimensions for the video display container.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies that the video will start over again every time it is finished.
explanation: The loop attribute replays the video indefinitely.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies that the audio output of the video should be muted.
explanation: muted mutes video audio tracks by default.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies an image to be shown while the video is downloading.
explanation: poster specifies a placeholder cover image prior to playback.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies if and how the video should be loaded when the web page loads.
explanation: preload accepts values like 'auto', 'metadata', or 'none'.

question: The ____________ attribute sets the width of the video player in pixels.
explanation: Width controls horizontal dimensions of video viewports.

question: An image with multiple hyperlinks is called an ____________.
explanation: An image map divides a single image into multiple clickable hotspot links.

question: An ____________ is used to connect links to different regions on a single web image.
explanation: Image maps map coordinate zones to distinct URL targets.

question: The clickable regions of an image map are called ____________.
explanation: Interactive clickable regions in image maps are called hotspots.

question: The ____________ tag is used to insert an image on a web page.
explanation: The tag embeds raster or vector images.

question: To create a Client-Side Image Map, the ____________ attribute of the tag is used.
explanation: usemap binds an element to a container.

question: The usemap attribute value in must be preceded with a ____________ symbol.
explanation: usemap references map names prefixed with a hash (e.g., usemap="#mymap").

question: The ____________ attribute acts as a pointer indicating that the image is a Client Side Image Map.
explanation: usemap signals client-side evaluation of map coordinates.

question: The ____________ tag is used to map clickable coordinates to an image.
explanation: The <map> tag encapsulates area definitions for image hotspots.

question: The ____________ attribute of <map> tag specifies the name linking it to the client-side image map.
explanation: The name attribute of <map> corresponds to the usemap reference on the image.

question: The ____________ tag defines specific clickable regions inside a <map>.
explanation: <area> elements describe shape, coordinates, and destination URLs.

question: The ____________ attribute of <area> tag defines the URL to which the clickable region navigates.
explanation: href points to the destination address when a hotspot is clicked.

question: The ____________ attribute defines the hotspot shape as rect, circle, or poly.
explanation: The shape attribute sets geometry (rect, circle, or poly).

question: The ____________ attribute specifies coordinates of clickable regions on the image map.
explanation: coords takes comma-separated pixel pairs mapping hotspot vertices.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies alternative text and extra accessibility information about a clickable area.
explanation: alt provides text alternatives for <area> tags.

question: The ____________ element creates an inline frame.
explanation: The <iframe> element embeds another document inside the current HTML page.

question: ____________ frames are often used in online advertising to embed external content.
explanation: Inline frames (iframes) serve dynamic advertising components.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies the address of the document to embed in the <iframe>.
explanation: src defines the target URL displayed inside the iframe.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies the height of an <iframe> in pixels.
explanation: height sets the frame's vertical dimensions.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies the width of an <iframe> in pixels.
explanation: width controls the frame's horizontal dimension.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies the reference name of an <iframe>.
explanation: name gives an iframe an identifier targets can reference in links.

question: The ____________ attribute specifies direct HTML content to show in the <iframe>.
explanation: srcdoc overrides src to display inline HTML markups directly.

question: A website is made available on the Internet with the help of ____________.
explanation: Web hosting provides the servers and bandwidth necessary to broadcast sites online.

question: ____________ is the service of providing storage space for websites on servers.
explanation: Web hosting provisions remote disk space and server compute.

question: Companies that provide web hosting services are called ____________.
explanation: Web hosts own and service server infrastructure.

question: ____________ own and manage web servers.
explanation: Web hosts manage physical machines and network lines.

question: ____________ hosting shares server resources across multiple sites and is cost-effective.
explanation: Shared hosting divides single server overhead across multiple consumer accounts.

question: ____________ are paid hosting servers reserved solely for a single large website.
explanation: Dedicated hosting reserves entire server hardware for a single client.

question: ____________ provides hosting of the website for a limited period of time at no cost.
explanation: Free hosting packages offer zero-cost introductory tier hosting.

question: Select TWO major web browsers that support the features of HTML5:
explanation: Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome are standard modern browsers that support HTML5.

question: The default range values of the range control are ____________ to ____________:
explanation: Without explicit min and max attributes, input type='range' defaults to 0 and 100.

question: Select TWO valid values for the 'type' attribute of the <input> tag:
explanation: date and email are valid type values. Minimum and Maximum are input attributes, not types.

question: Select TWO attributes of <input> tag used to specify minimum and maximum values for an input field:
explanation: min and max define numerical and date constraint boundaries.

question: The 'multiple' attribute of the <input> tag works with which TWO input types?
explanation: The multiple attribute is valid only on email and file types.

question: Select TWO valid attributes of the <meta> tag:
explanation: Charset and http-equiv are core attributes of the HTML5 <meta> tag.

question: Select TWO valid values for the 'http-equiv' attribute of the <meta> tag:
explanation: refresh and expires are standard HTTP response message header directives.

question: The charset attribute of <meta> tag uses ____________ for Indian characters and ____________ for Chinese characters:
explanation: UTF-8 encodes universal/Indian scripts, while Big5 encodes traditional Chinese.

question: A CSS rule set contains a ____________ and a ____________ block:
explanation: Every complete CSS rule set consists of a selector followed by a declaration block.

question: Select TWO examples of valid CSS declarations:
explanation: Declarations require a colon (:) between property and value.

question: The text-decoration property is used to add which TWO effects?
explanation: line-through and underline are valid CSS text-decoration property values.

question: Select TWO valid values for the 'text-align' property in CSS:
explanation: Valid text-align values include left, right, center, and justify.

question: Select TWO valid values for the 'border-style' property:
explanation: Solid and groove are standard CSS border styles.

question: The ID selector is written with the ____________ character and the Class selector with the ____________ character:
explanation: ID selectors use hash (#); class selectors use period (.).

question: Select TWO valid types of positioning in CSS:
explanation: Fixed and static are recognized CSS positioning methods.

question: Select TWO valid directional values for the CSS 'float' property:
explanation: CSS float supports left, right, and none.

question: Select TWO valid values for the CSS 'display' property:
explanation: Inline and block are core display values.

question: An ordered list can be ____________ or ____________:
explanation: Ordered lists support Arabic numbers and alphabetical characters.

question: Select TWO valid values for the 'type' attribute of the <ol> tag:
explanation: Valid <ol> types include 1, a, A, i, and I.

question: Select TWO valid attributes of the <ol> tag:
explanation: start and reversed are valid attributes on ordered lists.

question: List items start with the <li> tag in which TWO list elements?
explanation: Both <ol> and <ul> contain <li> child elements.

question: Select TWO valid values for the 'type' attribute of the <ul> tag:
explanation: disc, circle, and square are valid bullet shapes.

question: Which TWO tags are used to define items and descriptions in a definition list (<dl>)?
explanation: <dt> defines the term, and <dd> defines the definition data.

question: Select TWO types of nested lists supported in HTML:
explanation: Lists can be nested at a single sub-level or across multiple hierarchical levels.

question: Select TWO common audio file formats supported in HTML5:
explanation: .aac and .mp3 are standard audio codecs; .mp4 and .webm are video formats.

question: Select TWO valid attributes of the <audio> tag in HTML5:
explanation: autoplay and muted are audio attributes. Width and height apply to video.

question: Select TWO attributes of <audio> that are boolean (do not require values):
explanation: controls, muted, loop, and autoplay can stand alone as boolean attributes.

question: Select TWO common video formats supported in HTML5:
explanation: MP4 and WebM are standard container formats for HTML5 video.

question: Select TWO valid values for the 'preload' attribute of the <video> tag:
explanation: preload accepts auto, metadata, and none.

question: Select TWO attributes of the <video> tag used to control dimensions:
explanation: width and height specify video viewport size.

question: Image maps are primarily classified into which TWO types?
explanation: Image maps are classified as Client-Side or Server-Side.

question: Select TWO tags used to define a Client-Side Image Map:
explanation: A client-side image map is constructed using paired with .

question: A given ____________ element can contain multiple ____________ elements within it:
explanation: The <map> tag wraps multiple clickable <area> definitions.

question: Select TWO valid attributes of the <area> tag:
explanation: href and coords are core functional attributes of the <area> element.

question: Select TWO valid values for the 'shape' attribute of the <area> tag:
explanation: Valid HTML area shapes are rect, circle, and poly.

question: Select TWO valid attributes of the <iframe> tag:
explanation: src and srcdoc are specific to the <iframe> tag.

question: Select TWO valid categories of Website Hosting:
explanation: Shared hosting and Dedicated hosting are standard web hosting services.

question: Select THREE major web browsers that support HTML5 features:
explanation: Google Chrome, Safari, and Opera are modern browsers that fully implement HTML5.

question: <input type="date"> defines a date picker that captures which THREE fields?
explanation: A date picker selects year, month, and day.

question: Select THREE valid values for the 'type' attribute of the <input> tag:
explanation: date, email, and file are valid HTML5 input type values.

question: Select THREE valid attributes of the <input> tag:
explanation: autofocus, pattern, and multiple are valid <input> attributes.

question: Select THREE valid attributes of the <meta> tag:
explanation: Content, Charset, and Name are primary attributes of the <meta> tag.

question: The 'name' attribute of <meta> tag typically specifies metadata types such as which THREE?
explanation: Standard metadata name values include author, keywords, and description.

question: Select THREE valid values for the 'http-equiv' attribute of the <meta> tag:
explanation: Refresh, expires, and set-cookie are valid http-equiv header directives.

question: Select the THREE methods of implementing CSS in an HTML document:
explanation: CSS can be implemented via Inline styles, Internal/Embedded tags, or External files.

question: Select THREE valid values that can be assigned to the 'text-decoration' property in CSS:
explanation: line-through, underline, and overline are standard text-decoration lines.

question: Select THREE valid alignment values for the 'text-align' property in CSS:
explanation: left, right, and center are valid horizontal text-align values.

question: Select THREE valid CSS background/color properties:
explanation: color, background-image, and background-color are valid CSS properties.

question: Select THREE valid CSS properties used to control typographic fonts:
